meta.name: convert-documents-to-markdown
meta.description: Convert an attached Word document, presentation, spreadsheet, OpenDocument file, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF into local Markdown. Use when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把办公文档转成Markdown格式
copy.tagline_en: Turn office documents into local Markdown
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need office documents as Markdown

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把消息里给的本地附件(Word、演示文稿、表格、CSV、文本型 PDF 等)用容器内的 AnyDoc CLI 转成本地 Markdown,并告知输出文件路径;大文件只读取相关部分。
howto.when: 当消息提供了本地附件路径、需要读取文档又不上传到外部解析服务时触发,转换在 agent 容器内本地完成。

say.text: 转换这个文件,不要上传到外部解析服务
这个表格的百分比和隐藏行会保留吗
say.note: 会说明表格格式可能有损

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude converts a local attachment path (Word, slides, spreadsheets, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF) to Markdown using the local AnyDoc CLI inside the agent container, then prints the output path. Large files are read in relevant sections only.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a message supplies a local attachment path that must be read without uploading it to an external parser; conversion runs locally in the agent container.

say_en.note: Converts in the container and prints the output path

say_en.text: Convert this file, don't upload it to an external parser
Will the percentages and hidden rows survive in the Markdown?
say_en.note: It reports that spreadsheet formatting may be lossy
